metadata.description: Structured blockchain API skills for AI agents — spec-compliant endpoint routing, workflows, and integration patterns for 100+ chains. Eliminates hallucinated API calls across REST, WebSocket streaming, CLI, and pay-per-request (x402) interfaces.

plugins.name: goldrush-foundational-api
plugins.description: REST API for historical and near-real-time data across 100+ chains — balances, transactions, NFTs, prices.

plugins.name: goldrush-streaming-api
plugins.description: Real-time GraphQL subscriptions over WebSocket — OHLCV candles, DEX pairs, wallet activity

plugins.name: goldrush-cli
plugins.description: Terminal-first blockchain data tool with MCP support for Claude Desktop and Claude Code

plugins.name: goldrush-x402
plugins.description: Pay-per-request blockchain data via the x402 protocol — no API key, no signup, just a funded wallet
